chapter: Records, Lovie Austin and a first marriage
title: Lovie's Stutz with zebra trim; did she smoke or drink
summary: Hunter and Albertson recall Lovie's car with a zebra skin rug and possibly zebra-trimmed coat, and that she smoked but did not drink.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: So that proves that she was a wonderful woman. She loved automobiles. She had a Stutz car. And she had what is it -- trimmed like -- what is this, animals that have the stripes?
The tigers or leopard?
Leopard, no, not the dots, stripes.
Zebra?
Zebra. She had it trimmed, the rug on the floor of the car was like a --
Zebra skin?
Zebra skin, yeah. And then I -- if I'm
not mistaken, I might be mistaken, but I think Lovie had a coat made with this zebra skin. If it wasn't a whole coat, it was a collar and cuffs; however, I know that zebra skin was there someplace.
To match the car?
To match the car.
(Laughter)
That's very grand.
Yes, and let me see now. Did Lovie smoke? I think she did smoke. Do you remember -- you recall Lovie smoking?
I don't recall.
I don't recall. I don't want to say she did.
I have some pictures I took of her, and she wasn't smoking on any of them.
No, I don't think she smoked.
Oh, yes, she did, because I remember -- I remember her with her white hair and a cigarette dangling from her mouth, --
That's right. That's right.
-- sitting at the piano that morning.
She did smoke.
And we went out and --
And if I'm not mistaken, she always kept
a pack of cigarettes laying on the side of the seat by her.
Uh-huh.
Uh-huh, yes, she did smoke. But I -- she didn't drink, I don't think. I don't think Lovie drank.
No, not to my knowledge.
If she did, to my knowledge, in fact, I never saw her drink. If she did, in fact, I don't think she did --
